name: Iowa Prairie Network Small Grants Program
summary: Small grants of $500 to $3,000 for prairie restoration, management or protection projects, plus research, monitoring, education and training, with highest consideration for Iowa's old-growth remnant prairies.

geography.label: United States (priority for remnant prairies in Iowa)

eligibility.rule: A nonprofit, educational institution, local government or individual working in Iowa
Completing activities within 18 months of receiving funds
Asks for no applicant salaries, academic or agency salaries or overhead, lobbying or debt repayment

documents: Student advisor support letter, for student applications

status.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

deadline.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

administered_by.quote: IOWA PRAIRIE NETWORK GRANT APPLICATION Our mission: To learn about, teach about, enjoy and protect Iowa's prairie heritage.

geography.quote: Projects with positive expected impacts to Iowa's old growth, remnant prairies will receive highest consideration.

access.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

window.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

amount.quote: Project proposals in the amount of $500 - $3,000 will be considered for funding.

co_finance_required.quote: While matching funds are not required, they are encouraged-especially for larger projects.

effort.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

eligibility.quote: Nonprofit organizations, educational institutions, local government entities (e.g., municipalities, county conservation boards), and individuals working in Iowa are welcome to apply.
